name: Assassin Adept
description: Steeped in the ancient arts of far Cathay, the Assassin Adepts of clan Eshin command from the shadows and only strikes when the moment is right.

name: Black Skaven
description: Bred for strength, size and cruelty, the Black Skaven serve as the hulking bodyguards and executioners of Clan Eshin.

name: Eshin Sorcerer
description: These wiry, hooded warlocks combine martial discipline with black magic that bend shadows and wither the flesh.

choose.prompt: When recruiting this fighter, you must select one of the following abilities:

name: Giant Rat
description: Giant Rats are creations of the twisted genius of the Skaven. They are mutated monstrosities the size of dogs.

name: Night Runner
description: Nimble, swift, and fanatical in their pursuit of recognition, Night Runners throw themselves into danger with reckless abandon.
